text: There is a looping, almost hypnotic quality to hearing the same word repeated, 'Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.' I feel a strange sense of detachment, like everything around me—the glass meeting room full of people, the exhibition's bold colors and letters—exists at a slight remove. The discourse inside the glass room feels distant, while the R+D wall promises innovation and progress, yet leaves me pondering if repetition leads to understanding or if it breeds monotony. My presence here is both observed and observing, oscillating between participation and reflection. I feel curious, a little indifferent, and quietly amused by the cyclical nature of human interaction.
